newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal+ may seek soccer team listing, but not in 97.
newsitem.headline: Canal+ may seek soccer team listing, but not in 97.

text.p: French pay-television firm Canal Plus said on Monday it may eventually be interested in listing its Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) soccer team on the London stock exchange but that it had no plans to do so in 1997.
"A few teams are listed on the London exchange and they are doing well. We may eventually be interested for the PSG but there are no plans for 1997," a company spokeswoman told Reuters.
She made the comments following a rumour on the London market that Canal Plus was planning to list PSG in London.
